output.title: Check if ValidateCAA feature gate is configured
output.content: The cert-manager upgrade to v1.18.0 removes the deprecated `ValidateCAA` feature gate. While the environment shows cert-manager v1.17.0 is installed and will be upgraded, the provided configuration values (9 keys) do not reveal whether `ValidateCAA` is currently set. If the operator has explicitly configured this feature gate, they will see a warning log after upgrade; if not, the change is benign. Inspect your cert-manager Helm values, pod arguments, or ConfigMaps for any `ValidateCAA` feature gate settings before upgrading.
